promise: One useful self-discovery or learning experience a day; never a diagnosis or empty label.

rotation.reader_job: Give me language for a real pattern in how I work, decide or recover.
Show me one capacity I can strengthen without judging my worth.
Help me notice a communication or conflict pattern and try a better response.
Find the most useful gap in my household or family readiness.
Test whether I can distinguish sound health information from a persuasive claim.
Let me enjoy a surprising idea and understand how it works.
Show me how I react to headlines, uncertainty and online persuasion.

prohibited: prediction of illness, death, divorce, wealth or disaster
personality labels presented as fixed identity
collection of answers, health details or result bands
fear, shame, superiority or urgency used to force sharing or sign-up
unlicensed reproduction of proprietary test items
